Title: This KitKat Tastes Like Real Sake — But Has Basically No Alcohol

Description:
This Sakura Nihonshu KitKat from Don Quijote in Osaka genuinely tastes like sake — some say the flavor and aroma hit immediately, though not everyone agrees on how good it is. Flip the box over and the alcohol content is just zero point zero nine percent, well under Japan's one percent legal threshold for something to even count as alcohol, so it's officially sold as plain candy. It's not a real sake brewery collab either — Nestlé blended the flavor in-house — but the sake scent is real enough to make it a fun, buzz-free souvenir.
